context.why: First story of FS-031, the FairDM base images. This story delivers docker/Dockerfile (runtime and development targets), docker/entrypoint.sh (web start sequence, worker, pass-through; NOT yet the /docker-entrypoint.d start-steps loop, which is US2), docker/portal.Dockerfile (the example a portal copies, also used to build FairDM's demo), docker/smoke-test.sh (all checks except the start step), removal of COMPRESS_ENABLED and COMPRESS_OFFLINE from config/settings.py (decisions D8), and the rewrite of docs/portal-development/production.md for what this story delivers, plus CONTEXT.md terms and a changelog Added entry. No workflow files in this story: .github/ is US5 and US4.
spec_sections: What exists, and what this specification changes
prior_decisions: D1: the images contain no FairDM and no portal code.
D3: a production portal installs its dependencies on the development image and runs on the runtime image.
D4: the start sequence is migrate --noinput, collectstatic --noinput, compress, then gunicorn. Not django-setup-tools.
D6: no image exists for any release yet; portal.Dockerfile's FAIRDM_VERSION ARG has no default.
D8: delete COMPRESS_ENABLED = True and COMPRESS_OFFLINE = False from config/settings.py (lines 9-10).
D9 watch items: name every env var passed to docker run; smoke-test requests send X-Forwarded-Proto: https because production redirects to HTTPS (fairdm/conf/settings/security.py:36).
constitution: Article I: every change follows docs/contributing/standards/testing.md: what gets a test and what does not, test-first, structure and fixtures. Tests are grouped into Test<Subject> classes. A test whose subject is not a Python module is exempt from mirroring only when declared in [tool.forge.conformance] non-mirror-paths in pyproject.toml; add "tests/test_docker/" there (T001). Wording and appearance get no tests.
Article II: start with the simplest design that satisfies the spec. Article III: no wrapper layers or future-proofing indirection without a present second use.
Article VI: public changes ship their docs in the same pull request. Every documented example must work against the branch. Documentation describes behaviour in testable terms.
environment: Docker: use docker.exe (Docker Desktop on Windows, reachable from this WSL shell). The plain docker CLI gets permission denied on the socket. docker.exe accepts WSL paths for build contexts and bind mounts under /home.

Docker Desktop does not give containers the host's network like a Linux CI runner does. Make docker/smoke-test.sh work in both places: in CI it will run with a PostGIS service container on the runner's localhost (US5 wires that); locally, start postgis/postgis:17-3.5 on a user-defined docker network and run the portal container on the same network. Have the script take the database host and the network from environment variables with CI-suitable defaults, and document the local invocation in a comment at the top of the script.

Python tests: run with `uv run pytest -n0 tests/test_docker/` for your own tests. The full suite needs GDAL and the local PostGIS: export GDAL_LIBRARY_PATH=/home/sam/.local/opt/micromamba/root/envs/gis/lib/libgdal.so GEOS_LIBRARY_PATH=/home/sam/.local/opt/micromamba/root/envs/gis/lib/libgeos_c.so (the local PostGIS is already running on port 5432, socket in /tmp). The full verify at your section 5 is: `/home/sam/.openclaw/workspaces/forge/engineering-org/kit/forge verify --repo /home/sam/projects/worktrees/fairdm-031-base-image --base origin/main` with those two variables exported.

Entrypoint tests (T001, T002): run docker/entrypoint.sh with subprocess under /bin/sh, with PATH starting with a tmp_path directory of stand-in python, gunicorn and celery scripts that append their argv to a log file and exit with a status the test controls. No Docker in the Python tests.
acceptance: T001-T003: entrypoint tests written first, seen to fail, then green; failing migrate stops the start and gunicorn never runs.
T004-T006: both targets and the demo portal image build with docker.exe; docker/smoke-test.sh passes against them, every check printed. Paste its output into the T006 evidence.

T007: production.md describes the images, the example Dockerfile (by literalinclude of docker/portal.Dockerfile), the environment variables the smoke test needed, the worker, and the port; no mention of compose/production/django; the docs build passes (verify's docs step).
